scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rca/api" "npm run dev -w @rca/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rca/api && npm run build -w @rca/web
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 && npm run typecheck -w @rca/api && npm run typecheck -w @rca/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rca/api && npm run test -w @rca/web
